subject: design/implement-now-issue-entry
statement: Add an explicit one-issue entry to the existing implement-now command and skill. The invoking agent prepares a short typed intake; the Go entry exact-reads and freezes it, creates one current native task, and supplies only that task and its own review obligations to the existing dispatcher. The entry requires usable configured independent review and publishes a basic typed execution summary; verified completion requires the current proposal revision to match local verification, CI, and authenticated review.
